description: This file is a Java interface defining data access methods for CustomerAttribute entities in the shopizer project.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDao
classes.description: Java interface that extends a generic DAO for CustomerAttribute entities, providing methods to retrieve customer attributes based on different options and identifiers.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on the merchant store, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on the merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on the merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a specific merchant store and customer ID.
